specification.routing_basis: Nominal straight takeoff-to-guide 90 mm plus guide-to-body-exit 58 mm. Guide contact curvature and exit motion are unresolved; not a measured complete cable path.
specification.airflow_basis: Conditional EPP-500 forced-air requirement, not a selected fan or demonstrated installed flow.
specification.air_capacity_basis: Gross owner body volume times assumed air density and specific heat; upper bound on air-only storage before displaced volume. Structure has not been added to this node.
notes: CAD and catalog rotor inertia are included; rope mass and rotating bearing details remain additional uncertainty.
Electrical and motor thermal resistances/capacities remain reference proposals. Enclosure geometry does not validate those paths.
The smaller bank thermal capacity remains an assumption from data/compact_buffer.yaml.
No controller gains are retuned to make this candidate pass. Inertia feedforward uses the candidate plant parameters as in the reference controller.
